text:
Priya Patel: Thanks again for coming to the all-hands. Quick follow-up thread — a few people pinged me about exact delivery windows for the API latency improvements, Console rewrite previews, and the Optimize cost-suggest tooling. Can we surface owner names and rough rollout windows so teams can plan migrations?

Elaine Park: +1 — PM here. High level from product: API perf improvements (infra + kernel swaps) are targeted for a staged rollout in Q3, Console rewrite beta in late Q4, and Optimize recommendations v1 in early Q4. Need eng to confirm specifics.

Jordan Li: Eng reply: API perf work is split into two waves. Wave 1 (kernel selection + batching defaults) we aim to ship canary in mid-July and GA in early August. Wave 2 (KV cache persistence + prefix caching improvements) is experimental and tentatively Sept.

Mike Torres: From infra/sre: canary windows are 48h with traffic ramp to 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2 weeks if metrics look good. We need owners for the rollback playbook and the canary dashboards.

Priya Patel: Who will own the rollback/playbook? @Jordan? @Elaine?

Jordan Li: I can own rollback scripts and runtime changes (eng). Elaine can own comms & migration docs (PM). Mike to own alert thresholds + runbook integration with oncall.

Elaine Park: I'll draft the migration FAQ and a short checklist for customers. Want to include sample config snippets for Dedicated and Private. Example we discussed:

```json
{"auto_batching": "on", "cache_policy": "prefix_first", "max_latency_ms": 120}
```

Sara Nunez: FYI GTM: we need 2 weeks of notice before GA to update handouts and handoff to sales engineers. Beta invites should go to top 20 accounts first.

Priya Patel: Good call. Can we get a single-line owner mapping here so I can add to the all-hands follow-up email?

Jordan Li: API perf: Jordan Li (eng) — July canary / Aug GA.

Elaine Park: Console rewrite beta owner: Elaine Park (product) — closed beta late Oct, public beta early Nov.

Jordan Li: Optimize recommendations v1: Jordan + Applied ML team — internal beta late Sept, customer trials Oct -> GA early Nov.

Mike Torres: Canary/runbook: Mike Torres (sre) — will publish alert thresholds and runbook by 2025-06-25.

Priya Patel: Perfect. Can each owner drop one bullet in this thread by EOD with the single most important dependency you need? I'll consolidate.

Jordan Li: Dependency: kernel perf benchmarks on latest fw, and CI pipelines for canary traffic routing.

Elaine Park: Dependency: design signoff on migration UX and a docs writer to prep customer-facing FAQ.

Mike Torres: Dependency: feature flags and rollout tooling validated in staging; capacity reservation for canary traffic on Dedicated pools.

Sara Nunez: Dependency: list of beta accounts and a single SE point of contact per account.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job: canary-dashboard-create triggered for 2025-06-20 02:00 UTC

Priya Patel: Thanks all — I'll send the consolidated timeline + owners in the all-hands follow-up and set a quick 15m sync for next week to unblock dependencies. :thumbsup:
